Anna and the forgotten text

Anna has known a historical text for years. Previous editions are out of print; without linguistic and historical explanations, much remains incomprehensible. She wants to create a scientific edition with introduction and job commentary – preferably also as a book.

She works alone, among other obligations and with little budget. Her professional competence is there; for digital workflows she needs a prepared environment and achievable help. Time is the scarcest resource.

Later corrections, punctual counterreading and an excerpt for the teaching should remain possible.

The Key Question

How can Anna simply start and still keep opportunities open later?

P01-K01 · PERSONA · BACK SITE

Objectives and support

Minimum objective: audited, documented and releaseable edition data; agree on archiving and identification. Complement the web and print after effort.

Preferred route: Limited TEI model, prepared oXygen author/git environment, validation and local preview. A license has not yet been proven.

Easy to work: Main branch, meaningful commits, regular balancing and independent audited backup.

Institutional needs: Establishment, point-by-point advice, release support and export/transfer arrangements.

To discuss

What does Anna have to do herself? Which performance must be offered reliably?
